AboutPage.title: About Us
AboutPage.slide_1_text: HOLY DRIP didn't start as a business. It started as a haunting question: what can fashion reveal about the soul when the world around us crumbles? We didn't start with a product — but with a crisis. A philosophical one.
AboutPage.slide_2_text: Born in Kyiv — the cultural heart of Eastern Europe. A city where culture never surrendered, even when reality demanded it. At the moment when fashion became the last territory of independence, Holy Drip took its first breath.
AboutPage.slide_3_text: We took our time. For over a year we studied in silence: suppliers who guard quality like a sacred doctrine, logistics separating amateurs from institutions, European projects — their triumphs and fatal mistakes.
AboutPage.slide_4_text: Fashion is the language of the body, elevated to the frequency of the soul. Your form is divine architecture. Wear it with intention, not mediocrity. Commerce without honesty is blasphemy. Behind every transaction is a human.
AboutPage.slide_5_text: Holy Drip operates as curated access — not a marketplace. Every piece: hand-selected. Every search: personally executed. Every consultation: held by someone who knows your name.
AboutPage.slide_6_text: Our family — those seeking self-discovery through knowledge and clothing. We live at fashion parties, underground shows, sacred gatherings where style is a religion.
AboutPage.slide_7_text: Today, Holy Drip enters its first public chapter. If you seek more than clothing — if you seek transformation — Welcome.
AboutPage.slide_8_text: This project breathes and grows. You write our history. We stand at the beginning, but we will be remembered as the moment resale became a ceremony. History is forged.
